title: Sort the leaderboard
hints: `qsort` calls your comparator with two `const void *`. Convert them back: `const Player *a = pa;` (no cast needed from `void *` in C).
Compare scores first. Higher score first means: if `a->score > b->score` return a negative number. Only if the scores are equal, fall back to `strcmp(a->name, b->name)`.

Avoid `return b->score - a->score;`: with `INT_MIN` and `INT_MAX` that overflows (undefined behavior). Use `if (a->score != b->score) return a->score > b->score ? -1 : 1; return strcmp(a->name, b->name);`, then `qsort(players, count, sizeof *players, compare_players);`
